title: Chapter 147 Always At Your Service
content:
Chapter 147 Always At Your Service

"Aren't you the Spirit-Devouring Clan very powerful?"

Yan Lingyun said in a faint voice, her body began to get closer, and every step made all the Spirit-Devouring Tribe present tremble in the hearts.

A terrifying sense of oppression!

boom!

Yan Lingyun suddenly punched out.

Suddenly, a thunder sounded, and a fist light mixed with the aura of destruction rushed towards the countless spirit-eating people.

Seeing this terrifying blow, Shi Ren's expression was extremely solemn.

And countless spirit-eating races were even more scared!

"Mr. Ren!"

"Ah! Help!!"

"Stop it!"

Shi Ren rushed directly towards the fist light, and at the same time, an invisible force suddenly began to permeate the surface of his body.

The blast sounded.

A figure suddenly retreated from the void.

It is the devouring of the benevolence.

At this moment, blood kept flowing out of the corner of Ren's mouth.

At the same level, I didn't even take a single blow from the other party.

What kind of monster is this!

At this time, all the Spirit-Devouring Clans present finally retreated, leaving only the elites of their Spirit-Devouring Clan.

But at this moment, Shiren had already regretted his decision.

Not to mention the tribe members above the God-breaking Realm, even he himself is not sure at all. What can he do to fight against this monster-like woman in front of him?

At this time, Shi Chen appeared in front of Shi Ren.

"Mr. Ren."

Shi Ren shook his head, then looked at Yan Lingyun in the distance again.

At this moment, he finally realized why this woman was so confident and dared to break into their Soul-Devouring Territory alone.

This kind of strength is really unheard of.

Buzz —

No longer hesitated, Shi Ren directly held the jade talisman in his hand.

The next moment, a beam of light suddenly soared into the sky.

"Haha, I can't beat it, have you chosen to call someone?"

Yan Lingyun looked at Shi Ren's movements without any intention of interrupting them.

That's so confident.

"You're leaving now, it's still time."

Saren said in a low voice.

On the side, Shi Chen stared at Yan Lingyun in the void, without any concealment of the murderous intent in his eyes.

It’s a pity that he is not strong enough, and even Lord Ren can’t deal with this woman. How can he, a person who has just entered the mortal realm?

However, although he can't do it, it does not mean that the entire Spirit-Eating Clan cannot do it.

boom!

At this moment, the space in the field cracked again.

A first-handed Spirit-Eating Man appeared in the field.

Embers!

It is also the peak of the mortal realm.

"You are the ones who offended me, the Spirit-Devouring Clan?"

Ascension glanced at the scene, he immediately locked in Yan Lingyun standing in the void.

Suddenly, the expression of Ember trembled slightly.

The breath was not hidden at all.

How is this possible at the peak of the mortal realm?

There is such an existence outside.

Eagle frowned.

At this time, Shi Ren and Shi Chen came to Shi Jin's side.

"This woman is not simple."

Hearing this, Die Jin snorted, "So what?"

Buzz —

I saw that the surrounding space suddenly began to tremble violently.

The next moment, countless dense and strange runes suddenly appeared out of thin air in the field.

At the same time, a mysterious force suddenly attacked Yan Lingyun in the distance.

"Go together!"

In the void, sound came.

When Shi Ren and his friends heard this, they no longer hesitated.

boom!

The three rushed directly towards Yan Lingyun.

Bang bang bang!

The fighting sounded suddenly.

The scene suddenly emerged with a collapse of the sky and the earth.

One against three!

wrong!

The void trembled, and a phantom slowly emerged.

It is the Spirit-Devouring Clan that devours eternity.

The mysterious power just now came from his hands.

At this moment, with Shi Heng, the four people are fighting against Yan Lingyun.

However, Yan Lingyun did not retreat in a single step and fought back and forth with the four of them.

boom!

At this time, Shi Heng exerted his strength again, and the terrifying power continued to gush out from the surrounding space, shaking the entire void.

In this way, after a scream came.

Shichen couldn't hold on first and retreated from the battle.

At this time, the other three people also looked extremely gloomy.

The four of them couldn't even take over the woman in front of them.

Is there really such a terrifying existence in this world?

"Tell your clan leader to come out."

At this time, Yan Lingyun suddenly said coldly.

Hearing this, the few people were stunned and then became even more gloomy.

"What, don't you dare to come out?"

The field was silent for a while, and the next moment, a hideous laughter suddenly came from the void.

"Funny, fun."

"It has always been my Spirit-Devouring Clan invading others. This is the first time someone dares to break into my Spirit-Devouring Clan to kill all directions."

The crisp sound of footsteps sounded.

From a distance, I saw a creature that looked very human slowly coming from a distance.

The leader of the Spirit-Devouring Clan, the Spirit-Devouring.

"Class leader!"

Seeing the head of the Spirit-Devouring Clan, Shi Ren and the others looked a little excited.

Unexpectedly, the patriarch actually came out of seclusion so early.

"Class leader, you have to make the decision for us!"

At this time, Shi Chen rushed to the head of the Spirit-Devouring Clan, his face looking extremely sad.

However, the Spirit of Devouring did not pay attention to the Devouring Chen in front of him, but looked straight at Yan Lingyun in the distant void.

"You seem to be very strong."

Spirit Devourer showed a smile on his face, but in the eyes of others, it would appear extremely ferocious.

"You, seem very weak."

Yan Lingyun said in a calm voice.

Suddenly, Spirit Devourer's smile froze, replaced by a ferocious look.

And Shi Ren and his men had retreated to Spirit Devourer's side without knowing when.

......

Just like that, a great war began.

This battle shattered half of the Spirit Devourer Realm.

Countless Spirit Devourers died tragically in the fluctuations of this battle.

In the end, Yan Lingyun fought one against five, and frightened the entire Spirit Devourer Clan.

However, Yan Lingyun failed after all.

He lost due to the terrain.

In the Spirit Devourer Realm, the Spirit Devourer was almost immortal.

No matter how many times Yan Lingyun broke the Spirit Devourer, in the end, under the sacrifice of countless Spirit Devourers, the Spirit Devourer was resurrected again.

And those Soul Devouring people have no regrets about this. In their opinion, it is extremely glorious to be able to sacrifice for the clan leader.

"Hahahaha, woman, you can't kill me. After you die, I will completely devour the world you are in!"

The Soul Devouring's piercing voice continued to echo from the void.

Boom!

A roar sounded.

Yan Lingyun immediately stepped back a few steps. At this moment, her aura was no longer as strong as it was at the beginning.

Huh~

Yan Lingyun's face was a little ugly at this moment, especially when she saw the arrogant face of the Soul Devouring.

In the end, Yan Lingyun chose to die together.

Accompanied by a world-destroying explosion.

The entire Soul Devouring Realm was severely damaged.

"Ah! You, you lunatic!"

......

In the palace of the Divine Dynasty, Yan Lingyun retracted her thoughts.

She underestimated the enemy back then. This time, she will not repeat the same mistake.

Don't you like group fights?

Don't you like sacrifices?

You want to play? Fine, I'll play along.

I want to see what you can do to fight me.

At this moment, a mysterious aura slowly emanated from Yan Lingyun's body.

That was a sign of imminent transformation!
